title: TrustBridge reason_code Catalog
description: Canonical catalog of all reason_code values emitted by the trustbridge-action `reason_code` output and the `reasonCode` field in ValidationResult. These codes are a public API surface: dashboard automations and workflow gates switch on them. Renames and removals are BREAKING CHANGES requiring a MAJOR version bump. New codes are ADDITIVE and safe in any minor/patch release. Source of truth: src/checks.ts. See docs/USAGE.md#reason-code-reference for the full documentation table.

codes.description: All checks passed — the account is funded, holds the required asset trustline, and meets the minimum XLM reserve.
The account is funded and meets the XLM reserve, but the required asset trustline is not present.
The account is funded and has a trustline, but the native XLM balance is below the required minimum reserve.
The account is funded and has a trustline, but the trustline limit is below the configured minimum (`min_trustline_limit`).
codes.emittedBy: src/checks.ts (runValidationChecks, only when min_trustline_limit is set)

codes.description: Horizon returned 404 for the account — the account does not exist on the Stellar network (not yet funded).
The Horizon request timed out or was aborted. The account state could not be determined.
codes.emittedBy: src/checks.ts (horizonFailureResult, when error message contains 'timeout' or 'timed out')

codes.description: Horizon returned a non-404 non-timeout error (e.g. 429, 502, 503, 504, or a non-retryable HTTP error). The account state could not be determined.
TLS/certificate verification failed for the configured Horizon endpoint. The account state could not be determined. Most common with private/enterprise Horizon mirrors using self-signed certificates.
A generic failure catch-all: the account was funded and the trustline exists and the reserve was met, but some other check (e.g. asset balance minimum) caused the validation to fail.
codes.emittedBy: src/checks.ts (runValidationChecks fallback when no specific code applies)

codes.description: The milestone gate skipped validation because the issue's milestone was not in the allowlist. No account checks were performed.
